items.question: Which additional food items are included in the prepared ritual offering mixture?
premises: Sesame-rice dish is listed as an offering item.
Ghee and parched flour are included among the items.
Sweet balls are added to complete the mixture.
items.inference: The prepared ritual offering mixture includes sesame-rice dish, ghee, parched flour, and sweet balls together.
